notes.title: 【New Game Update Details】
notes.content:
Breakers! Install the latest update to add new Mobile Suits, improve stability of gameplay, and fix various bugs. Please apply the latest patch and continue to BREAK, BUILD and BATTLE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899826/127d66a2c483e2ebf9b7710b5e3e22434b0b1b34.jpg[/img]

●Major Updates

【New Mobile Suits Added!】
・GQuuuuuuX
・Gundam EX (Gundam: Requiem for Vengeance)

They will be available for purchase in the in-game store.

【Newly Added! Master Skills Settings】
When using master skills, a new setting has been added to display a hologram of the master skill without replacing the mastered parts, while still showing the currently equipped part. (This can be switched in the configuration.)

【More items and functions!】
・Adjustment on Mighty Strike Freedom Gundam
The effects of the Burst Actions 'Proud Defender' and 'Convergent Heavy Nucleon Beam Cannon Disruptor' have been updated. Additionally, Futsunomitama has been added as a Close-Range weapon. To obtain the Futsunomitama, you will need to repurchase the Mighty Strike Freedom Gundam from the in-game store.

・Added New builders parts.
・Added New paint patterns.
・Added New diorama objects.
・Added Photograph poses to the diorama mode.
・Added the ability to display area limits on the map (This can be switched in the configuration.)
・The updated Wingman Settings are now applied to other missions.

Installing update is required for all online play. 
More updates are still to come for Gundam Breaker 4!

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Notice of New Game Update
notes.content:
The latest patch for Gundam Breaker 4 is ready to deploy! This update aims to improve gameplay and fix some outstanding bugs.

▼Major Updates fixes
・Adjusting the Long-Range Weapon and Long-Range Skill
Increased attack power and ammo for most Long-Range Weapon and Long-Range Skill.

・Adjustments to the “Greatsword” weapon category 
Ground Break with Greatsword is now possible, and the parts have increased drop rate. 

・Equip Pair Function on Builders' Parts has been improved
When eqipping Builder's Parts in pairs, it is now possible to equip them even if there is no empty slot for both parts (but one of the slots must be empty).

・Add a function to send diorama works to the Diorama Monitor
Added a function to switch diorama works displayed on the monitor in the lobby.

・Added a function to paste labels on the Results Screen
A label pasting function has been added to parts and weapons acquired on the Results Screen.

Installing update is required for all online play. More updates are still to come for Gundam Breaker 4!
 
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Notice of New Game Update
notes.content:
The latest patch for Gundam Breaker 4 is ready to deploy! This update aims to improve gameplay and fix some outstanding bugs.
 
▼Issue fixed with the Diorama Pack 4 – Beach Set & Effect where 7 out of the 20 effects were unavailable, allowing you to now obtain the 7 types of effect sets (such as Ballistic Ammo/Muzzle Flash).
 
If you have already purchased the DLC 4, apply the update and then launch the game. You will be able to see the dialog announcing the purchase of Diorama DLC 4 again.
 
▼Major Updates fixes
・Fix claw combo attacks
・Fix weapon skill “Bazooka <Beam Bazooka>” when equipped to the left arm.
・Fix weapon skill “Katana” 
・Fix GN Particles to appear correctly.
・Fix distorted visual of the Mobile Suit when using certain skills or weapons.
・Correct sorting of Ability Cartridges.
・Correct firing ray of OP skill “5-Barrel Finger Vulcan” shifting upwards under specific conditions.
・Fix a bug that prevented offline players from receiving event rewards after coming back online. (To receive event rewards, you must be online before the deadline.)
 
Installing update is required for all online play. More updates to come for Gundam Breaker 4. 
 
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: 【Details of the new update patch】
notes.content:
This update includes new Mobile Suits, improvements to gameplay stability and fixes for some of the known issues. Please update to the latest patch for the best experience! 

[h3]◆Details of update[/h3]
・Added a configuration option to turn on/off the warning display when selling or combining parts saved in the high rarity/inherent or single unit/label/blueprint categories
・Added a sort filter for individual abilities on the assembly screen
・Added “Order of Creation” to the sort options on the assembly screen 
・Added a shortcut button for labels on the assembly screen
・With the exception of some skills, a setting has been added to the configuration that allows you to activate Builder's Parts skills while maintaining their position and size, etc. 
・A shortcut to the shop has been added to the menu in the lobby 
・With the exception of some parts, the emissive color has been reflected in the GN particle effects 
・The lock-on function would not focus on the destructed part without a break point in the boss battle
・ Improved the camera mouse control in the lobby and during missions on the Steam.

Online play requires the player to apply this update.

Further updates will be distributed in the future for you to continue to enjoy Gundam Breaker 4 more comfortably. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: 【Details of new game update】
notes.content:
Update data to add new Mobile Suits, improve stability of gameplay, and fix some issues are now deployed.
Please apply the latest patch and enjoy GB4! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899826/2699b802adf4128fde6ba4ac9d82a5530f0f989c.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]●Major Updates[/b][/h3]

The following Mobile Suits have been added to the in-game store: 
・Mighty Strike Freedom Gundam
・Gundam Calibarn
・Gundam Calibarn [Permet Score Five]

[h3][b]●Issues that are fixed:[/b][/h3]

・The notification for unlocking the functions of diorama mode and custom pose displayed every time a mission was cleared 
・The booster effect does not disappear in the multi-lobby
・Certain backpacks do not display properly when using master skills.
・Some backpacks are not changeable when equipped the “Melee” weapon
・When viewing other players' Gunpla, the rotation operation of it spins at too high a speed 
・Installation-type skills such as “Mine” and “Dummy Shell” do not generate damage against giant bosses.
・Upper body does not rotate when performing the spinning and shooting motion. 
・When changing the size of leg parts, the attack criteria changes. 
・Burst action “Full Burst” keeps activating even after the skill ends. 

[h3][b]●Adjustment of Game Balance[/b][/h3]

・The attack frequency rate of funnel skills has been increased.
・Adjusted the speed of firing of some machine gun category weapons.
・Reduced the damage of continuous thrust attacks with maces and other weapons.
・Increased the damage of the “Legilis Cannon” skill.

Application of this update is required for online play.
We will continue to make improvements to “Gundam Breaker 4”.
Thank you for your continued support!
